seo.title: Crepuscularity — Fast, type-safe DSL for GPUI & Web
seo.description: Scaffold, develop, and deploy GPUI applications and static websites with a modern, hot-reloading DSL.

props.headline: Build Beautiful Native Apps and Web Sites
props.subheadline: Crepuscularity is a modern DSL and CLI for the GPUI framework. Hot-reload, type-safety, and seamless cross-platform deployment.

props.title: Everything you need to ship fast

items.title: Powerful CLI
items.description: Scaffold projects, start a hot-reload dev loop, and build for production with a single command: `crepus dev`.

items.title: Modern DSL
items.description: A familiar, type-safe syntax for building UI components that works across GPUI and the web.

items.title: Hot Reload
items.description: See your changes instantly with a sub-second hot-reload loop that maintains application state.

items.title: Web & Native
items.description: Write once, deploy everywhere. Render your components to native GPUI windows or static HTML.

items.title: Component Library
items.description: Build reusable UI components with slots, props, and conditional styling out of the box.

items.title: Browser Extensions
items.description: Scaffold and build browser extensions with Rust and WASM using the same familiar DSL.
